about:
Acuity Medical Inc was founded in 1987 in Annapolis, Maryland. The company operates as a medical device manufacturer, specialty distributor, and contract sales agency. Mark Tomchik, formerly vice president of sales and marketing at Vapotherm, purchased the business and has served as president since at least 2003, bringing experience from senior roles at Optiva Corporation (maker of Sonicare) and Thermoscan (now part of Braun).

Acuity Medical combines manufacturing with a national sales and distribution platform. The company maintains a warehouse and customer-service infrastructure in Annapolis to support wholesale distribution, staging, assembly, installation, and white-glove delivery. Its corporate team includes operations, warehouse, marketing, and service-and-installation personnel, while a field sales force of roughly 30 representatives covers hospital, alternate-care, and HME/DME channels across the United States. The firm also runs the Partner Focus Program (PFP), a custom business-planning framework for its contract-manufacturer partners, and executes integrated marketing campaigns that blend face-to-face presentations, e-marketing, telemarketing, and trade-show presence.

The company serves the healthcare continuum, with a focus on medical/surgical markets. Its customer base includes integrated delivery networks (IDNs), hospitals, alternate-care facilities, and home medical equipment (HME) and durable medical equipment (DME) providers. Sales representatives are assigned to specific territories such as hospital markets in New England, alternate-care in Florida, and HME/DME in the Mid-Atlantic.

Acuity Medical emphasizes its award-winning track record and a results-driven approach built on high call frequency, trusted leadership, and a structured Partner Focus Program. The company states its mission is to deliver quality products, personalized customer service, detailed clinical support, and a strong value proposition to its customers.
